reviews.text: An excellent store with a large selection of dog and cat grooming products. The staff is very pleasant and qualified, they professionally selected the right product for me, and the atmosphere is pleasant and welcoming.
I loved my experience here! The animals are the absolute cutest and I could not speak more highly of the staff. I highly recommend!!!
The staff were so nice!!! The location is hard to find. There was a grumpy cat there.

The staff are incredibly knowledgeable!

They can answer any question.

They have a wide variety of animals.

The only downside is that it's far from the station.

This pet shop (or perhaps pet salon?) has a very homey atmosphere; the staff are friendly and chatty, and adorable parrots and puppies greet you upon arrival. They also have a pet hotel, and unusually, there were birds staying there when I visited. Two puppies were roaming freely, and my friend who accompanied me had a great time. I was looking for a rainbow parakeet to tame and it was fate! I finally brought one home. It's very friendly and you can tell it was loved at the pet shop 🤭🫶🏻 Thank you so much for teaching me so much about parakeets 😊

There was a staff member I'd love to see again.

My child had a fun experience that they don't often get to have.

Above all, the staff explained pet care in an easy-to-understand way, and it's a warm and friendly shop.
